sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
to be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title 
block

There are two drainage pumps one in the North main sump tank and the other in 
the South main sump tank and their types are CP3300 ( used for draining the main sump 
tanks )

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abd Elnabi Ibrahim, revised and tested by eng. Al-Sayed Ibrahim Al-Ashmony, accepted 
by eng. Abd elghaffar Osman: general director, and approved by eng. Ahmed 
Mohamed Yonis; Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1 & 2 Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director 
and MPIS Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
Pump should be out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically and electrically,

sections.text: تحذير:

Resulting from leakage, there may be over pressure in the stator casing. Hold 
 a rag over the inspection screw to prevent splatter.

Tilt the 
 pump so that any liquid in the stator casing can run out through the hole.

If there 
 is water in the stator casing the cause may be:
- That the inspection cover (13) is no tight enough 
 that O ring (13) is damaged.
 - That cable entries ( 1 , 2 ) are leaking.

If there oil in the stator casing the cause may be: 
- That the inner mechanical seal (12) is damaged 
 and must be replaced.
 - That an O ring (3) is damaged and must be replaced.

Check the 
 cable entry: make sure that the cable clamps are tight.

Check the 
 pipes, valves.

Lay down the 
 pump in it is seat and sure that it is in proper position.

Check the 
 function of operation of the pump.
